task.summary: Add new page to save new addresses

Add functionality for managing and displaying addresses
Introduced new pages and routes for managing addresses, including adding, displaying, and navigating address details. Refactored buttons and associated scripts for better user interaction and updated models to support email notifications. Improved EJS templates with dynamic page titles and resolved IDE warnings for valid template expressions.

Enhance address management functionality and update dependencies
Refactored the application to improve address management by introducing new pages and routes for creating, displaying, and editing addresses. Updated front-end assets and EJS templates to enhance user interaction and design. Additionally, dependencies like `cheerio`, `date-fns`, `method-override`, and `morgan` were added for extended functionality, and outdated IntelliJ configuration files were removed. Added functionailty to collect bin dates

Streamline bin collection dates service with modelData parsing and deduplication
- Refactored `getCollectionDatesThisYear` to parse modelData JSON, deduplicate collection dates, and sort results for improved accuracy. - Introduced helper functions: `parseDotNetDate`, `extractModelDataFromHtml`, `parseMonthCollectionDates`, and `dedupeByUprnTypeDate`. - Updated mongoose schema and backend configuration related to bin collection data handling. - Enhanced development environment with a new `dev` npm script for debugging using nodemon.
